hero.title: Empowering Newcomers, Building Futures
hero.subtitle: Since 2008, WORI has been a beacon of hope for refugees and immigrants across Canada.

vision.text: Refugees and immigrants, especially those who have experienced wars and persecution, leading self-sufficient and dignified lives in a socially inclusive society.

about.description: Wadi-Kaja Organization for Refugees and Immigrants (WORI) is a non-profit organization in Toronto, Canada. The organization helps with refugees, and new immigrants in GTA. The organization also provides settlement services, translation and interpretation for new immigrants to Canada.

impact.label: Our Impact
impact.title: Every life we touch strengthens the fabric of our communities
impact.description: From emergency housing to career mentorship, WORI delivers comprehensive settlement and wellbeing services tailored to the unique journeys of refugees and immigrants in Canada.

hero.title: Autonomiser les Nouveaux Arrivants, Bâtir l'Avenir
hero.subtitle: Depuis 2008, WORI est un phare d'espoir pour les réfugiés et immigrants au Canada.

vision.text: Les réfugiés et immigrants, en particulier ceux qui ont vécu des guerres et des persécutions, menant des vies autonomes et dignes dans une société socialement inclusive.

about.description: Wadi-Kaja Organization for Refugees and Immigrants (WORI) est une organisation à but non lucratif à Toronto, Canada. L'organisation aide les réfugiés et les nouveaux immigrants dans le Grand Toronto.

impact.label: Notre Impact
impact.title: Chaque vie que nous touchons renforce le tissu de nos communautés
impact.description: Du logement d'urgence au mentorat professionnel, WORI offre des services complets d'établissement et de bien-être.

hero.badge: جمعية خيرية مسجلة في كندا — رقم: 748873338RR0001
hero.title: تمكين القادمين الجدد، بناء المستقبل
hero.subtitle: منذ عام 2008، كانت WORI منارة أمل للاجئين والمهاجرين في جميع أنحاء كندا.

vision.text: اللاجئون والمهاجرون، ولا سيما أولئك الذين عانوا من الحروب والاضطهاد، يعيشون حياة كريمة ومعتمدة على الذات في مجتمع شامل.

about.description: منظمة وادي كاجا للاجئين والمهاجرين هي منظمة غير ربحية في تورنتو، كندا. تساعد المنظمة اللاجئين والمهاجرين الجدد في منطقة تورنتو الكبرى.

impact.label: تأثيرنا
impact.title: كل حياة نلمسها تعزز نسيج مجتمعاتنا
impact.description: من الإسكان الطارئ إلى التوجيه المهني، تقدم WORI خدمات شاملة للاستقرار والرفاهية.

hero.title: አዲስ መጤዎችን ማብቃት፣ መስተጋብር መሥራት
hero.subtitle: ከ2008 ጀምሮ WORI ለስደተኞች እና ለወሰን ተሻጋሪዎች በካናዳ አንድ ተስፋ ብርሃን ነበረች።

vision.text: ስደተኞች እና ወሰን ተሻጋሪዎች፣ በተለይም ጦርነት እና ስደት ያሳለፉ፣ ዋስ ስሜት ካለ ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ሙሉ ህይወት ይኖሩ።

about.description: WORI ካናዳ ቶሮንቶ ውስጥ ለስደተኞች እና ለወሰን ተሻጋሪዎች አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ ድርጅት ነው።

impact.label: የእኛ ተጽእኖ
impact.title: እያንዳንዱ ሕይወት የምንነካው ማህበረሰባችንን ያጠናክራል
impact.description: WORI ለስደተኞች እና ወሰን ተሻጋሪዎች አጠቃላይ አገልግሎቶችን ትሰጣለች።

hero.title: Xoojinta Kuwa Cusub, Dhismaha Mustaqbalka
hero.subtitle: Tan iyo 2008, WORI waxay ahayd geesi u soo jeeda qaxootiga iyo muhaajiriinta ee Kanada.

vision.text: Qaxootiga iyo muhaajiriinta, gaar ahaan kuwa la kulmay dagaallada iyo silcinta, ku nool nolosha xurta iyo sharafta leh bulshada ku jirta.

about.description: WORI waa urur aan faa'iido doon ahayn oo ku yaalla Toronto, Kanada oo u adeega qaxootiga iyo muhaajiriinta cusub.

impact.label: Saamayntaadeena
impact.title: Nolol kasta aan taabano way xoojineysa gudaha bulshooyinkeena
impact.description: WORI waxay bixisaa adeegyo dhammaystiran oo dejinta iyo nafaqada ah.

hero.title: ምህዋር ንመጻእቲ፡ መወዳእታ ንድሕነት
hero.subtitle: ካብ 2008፡ WORI ንስደተኛታትን ስደተኛታትን ኣብ ካናዳ ተስፋ ትህብ።

vision.text: ስደተኛታት፡ ብፍላይ ናይ ኲናትን ስደትን ዝወሰዱ፡ ምሉእ ናጻ ህይወት ኣብ ሕብሪ ሕብሩ ሕብረተሰብ ይንብሩ።

about.description: WORI ኣብ ቶሮንቶ ካናዳ ንስደተኛታትን ስደተኛታትን ኣገልግሎት ዝህብ ዘይርዶ ትካል እዩ።

impact.title: እንነኣስ ብዝነኣስ ነብሪ ነብሪ ንምህዋር
impact.description: WORI ንስደተኛታትን ስደተኛታትን ኣጠቃሊ ኣገልግሎታት ትህብ።
